findings.message: The chunks of track 1 hold 10 samples, but stsz sizes 20; the 10 samples after them have no place in the file.
The access unit at 0x3DD holds 16 bytes after the END element of its raw data block.
The raw data block at 0x404 holds a TNS filter of a higher order than the 12 its window allows.
The PCE at 0x419 runs past the end of its access unit; the rest of its raw data block is not read.
3 raw data blocks hold an ics_reserved_bit of 1, where the specification requires 0; the first at 0x41D.
3 raw data blocks are not read to their end; in the first, the ICS Info at 0x41F sets predictor_data_present, which AAC LC does not define.
